title: Longer Records, Broader Invariance: The Hidden Scaling Problem in Longitudinal Contrastive Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.36409v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Longitudinal data are valuable because people change. Yet the objectives used to learn from these data can inadvertently erase that change. In person-level contrastive learning, observations from the same person are treated as positives; as records grow, those positives can span increasingly distant---and increasingly different---behavioral states. More history can therefore produce not only more data, but broader invariance. We show that this distinction is fundamental. We separate \emph{record span}, how much history the learner sees, from \emph{supervision span}, how far across that history positive-pair supervision reaches. Across in-home sensing records spanning up to 2.7 years, broader supervision systematically suppresses recoverable changing-state information, even when the available history is held fixed. At the broadest span, less than 10\% of the information recoverable from an untrained encoder remains. Yet keeping positive

translated_title: 更长的记录，更广的不变性：纵向对比学习中的隐含缩放问题
translated_abstract: 纵向数据之所以有价值，是因为人会随时间变化。然而，用于从这些数据中学习的目标函数可能会在无意中抹去这种变化。在个人层面的对比学习中，来自同一个人的观测被视为正样本；随着记录的增长，这些正样本可能跨越越来越遥远——且差异越来越大——的行为状态。因此，更多的历史数据不仅意味着更多的数据，还可能意味着更广的不变性。我们证明这一区别是根本性的。我们将“记录跨度”（即学习者能看到多少历史）与“监督跨度”（即正样本对监督在该历史中延伸的距离）区分开来。在跨越长达2.7年的居家感知记录中，更广的监督会系统性地抑制可恢复的变化状态信息，即使可用历史保持固定不变。在最广的跨度下，未训练编码器可恢复的信息中只有不到10%得以保留。然而，保持正样本……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了纵向对比学习中的隐含缩放问题：正样本监督跨度的扩大（而非仅仅是记录的增多）会系统性地抹除个体随时间变化的状态信息，在最广监督跨度下可恢复的变化信息不足未训练编码器的10%。
